equalizer.title: Equalizer
equalizer.compareHint: Hold to hear the original sound, tap to switch and tap again to come back. Your curve stays untouched.
equalizer.notBitPerfect: While the equalizer, Deep Bass or loudness compensation is on, the sound is processed and playback is not bit-perfect.

curve.title: Frequency response
curve.ariaLabel: Frequency response of the equalizer from 20 Hz to 20 kHz
curve.clip: The signal reaches the maximum level
curve.clipHint: Lights up when the output reaches 0 dB. Lower the preamp or turn on auto headroom.
curve.parametricHint: Drag a point to change frequency and gain, use the mouse wheel for Q, double-click the curve to add a filter.

bands.hint: ±12 dB in 0.5 dB steps. Double-click a slider to reset it. With the keyboard use the arrow keys (Shift for bigger steps), Page up and Page down.

parametric.empty: No filters yet. Add one to shape the sound.
parametric.limitReached: The maximum number of filters is in use.

preamp.title: Preamp
preamp.label: Preamp
preamp.autoHint: Lowers the level by the highest boost of your curve, so boosting never overloads the output.

bass.title: Deep Bass
bass.hint: Adds low-end weight and generated harmonics, so bass stays audible on small speakers and headphones.

more.title: More
more.loudnessHint: Raises bass and treble when the volume is low, because the ear is less sensitive to them then.
more.limiterHint: Keeps peaks below -1 dBTP. Needed when you boost without automatic headroom. Off keeps playback bit-perfect.

presets.label: Preset
presets.name: Name
presets.deleteHint: The preset is removed from this device. Your current sound stays as it is.

share.title: Share preset
share.description: Copy the text to share your current sound. To import, paste a preset text and press Import.
share.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
share.invalid: This text is not a valid preset.

autoEq.title: Import AutoEQ profile
autoEq.description: Paste the contents of a ParametricEQ.txt or pick the file. The filters appear in the parametric mode.
autoEq.readFailed: The file could not be read.
